metadata.name: ByteBell Cross-Repository Impact Analysis Evaluation Dataset
metadata.description: 100 cross-repository file-level impact test cases across 15 A_kubernetes repos

evaluation_criteria.precision: % of predicted affected files that are actually affected
evaluation_criteria.recall: % of actual affected files that were predicted
evaluation_criteria.f1_score: Harmonic mean of precision and recall

source_change.description: Add a new method WaitForCacheSync(ctx context.Context) bool to the SharedInformer interface in k8s.io/client-go/tools/cache. SharedInformer is the core interface used across the Kubernetes ecosystem to watch and cache API resources. Any type that implements SharedInformer (e.g. custom informers) or wraps it must now satisfy this new method, breaking all downstream consumers that embed or implement the interface.
source_change.specific_change: Add `WaitForCacheSync(ctx context.Context) bool` method to SharedInformer interface

expected_affected_files.reason: Helm wait.go imports k8s.io/client-go/tools/cache and uses cache informer patterns for resource readiness checking
ArgoCD uses SharedInformer extensively for watching Application CRDs, Secrets, ConfigMaps, and cluster resources
Ingress-nginx uses cache.Store and SharedInformer for watching Ingress, Secret, Service, and ConfigMap resources
External-DNS uses cache.SharedInformer for watching Services, Ingresses, CRDs, and Gateway resources
Cert-manager controllers use SharedInformer for watching Certificates, CertificateRequests, Secrets, and Issuers
Autoscaler VPA and cluster-autoscaler use SharedInformer for watching Pods, VPA objects, and controller resources

source_change.description: Change the TLSClientConfig field in rest.Config (k8s.io/client-go/rest) from a value type to a pointer type (*TLSClientConfig). rest.Config is the primary struct used to configure Kubernetes API client connections. Any code that directly assigns or constructs rest.TLSClientConfig{} literals on a rest.Config will break because the field now expects a pointer, requiring &rest.TLSClientConfig{} instead.
source_change.specific_change: Change `TLSClientConfig TLSClientConfig` to `TLSClientConfig *TLSClientConfig` (value to pointer)

expected_affected_files.reason: ArgoCD directly assigns and constructs rest.TLSClientConfig structs in SetK8SConfigDefaults() and RawRestConfig() for multi-cluster TLS configuration
Ingress-nginx creates a rest.TLSClientConfig{} and assigns CAFile before setting cfg.TLSClientConfig in createApiserverClient()

source_change.description: Change the Containers field in corev1.PodSpec (k8s.io/api/core/v1) from []Container to a new named type ContainerList with different iteration semantics. PodSpec is used everywhere pods are created or inspected. Any code that directly ranges over pod.Spec.Containers, indexes into it (pod.Spec.Containers[0]), or assigns []corev1.Container{} literals will break because ContainerList is no longer a plain slice.
source_change.specific_change: Change `Containers []Container` to `Containers ContainerList` where ContainerList is a new named type with different iteration semantics

expected_affected_files.reason: ArgoCD directly accesses pod.Spec.Containers: info.go uses len(pod.Spec.Containers) and range pod.Spec.Containers; terminal.go iterates pod.Spec.Containers for exec
Cert-manager constructs Containers: []corev1.Container{...} and accesses pod.Spec.Containers[0] for ACME HTTP-01 challenge pods

source_change.description: Change the Type field in corev1.ServiceSpec (k8s.io/api/core/v1) from value type ServiceType to pointer type *ServiceType. Service.Spec.Type is read by controllers, ingress controllers, and DNS providers to determine routing behavior (e.g. LoadBalancer vs ClusterIP). Any code that compares svc.Spec.Type == corev1.ServiceTypeLoadBalancer or switches on the value will break because pointer dereferencing and nil checks are now required.
source_change.specific_change: Change `Type ServiceType` to `Type *ServiceType` (value to pointer) in ServiceSpec

expected_affected_files.reason: Helm checks Service.Spec.Type for LoadBalancer readiness evaluation
ArgoCD checks Service.Spec.Type for health status and load balancer ingress status
Ingress-nginx accesses Service.Spec.Type for backend routing and endpoint resolution
External-DNS reads Service.Spec.Type to determine DNS endpoint generation for LoadBalancer/NodePort services
Cert-manager creates Service objects for ACME HTTP-01 challenge solving

source_change.description: Change the Rules field in networkingv1.IngressSpec (k8s.io/api/networking/v1) from []IngressRule to a new named type IngressRuleList with different accessor methods. Ingress.Spec.Rules is the primary field that ingress controllers, cert managers, and DNS providers iterate to extract hostnames, paths, and backend configurations. Any code that ranges over ingress.Spec.Rules or appends to it as a plain slice will break.
source_change.specific_change: Change `Rules []IngressRule` to use a new IngressRuleList type with different accessor methods

expected_affected_files.reason: Ingress-nginx directly iterates Ingress.Spec.Rules in store.go and main.go to build nginx configuration
Cert-manager reads and constructs Ingress.Spec.Rules for ACME HTTP-01 challenge Ingress objects
External-DNS reads Ingress.Spec.Rules to extract hostnames for DNS endpoint creation

source_change.description: Add a context.Context parameter to the Matches method on the Selector interface in k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/labels. The labels.Selector interface is used pervasively across the Kubernetes ecosystem for filtering resources by label selectors. Changing Matches(Labels) bool to Matches(ctx context.Context, Labels) bool breaks all call sites that invoke .Matches() and all custom implementations of the Selector interface.
source_change.specific_change: Change `Matches(labels Labels) bool` to `Matches(ctx context.Context, labels Labels) bool` in Selector interface

expected_affected_files.reason: Helm uses labels.Selector for filtering Secrets/ConfigMaps in storage drivers, waiting for resources, and listing releases
ArgoCD uses labels.Selector for filtering Applications, ApplicationSets, and settings resources
Ingress-nginx uses labels.Selector for filtering Ingresses and Services by watch namespace
External-DNS uses labels.Selector for filtering source resources across all source types
Cert-manager uses labels.Selector for filtering ACME challenge pods/ingresses and certificate resources
Autoscaler uses labels.Selector for VPA target matching and cluster-autoscaler pod/node listing

source_change.description: Add a context parameter to the GetMeta() method on RNode in sigs.k8s.io/kustomize/kyaml/yaml. RNode is the core exported type for representing and manipulating Kubernetes YAML resource documents in kustomize. Changing the signature from GetMeta() (ResourceMeta, error) to GetMeta(ctx context.Context) (ResourceMeta, error) breaks all downstream callers that invoke manifest.GetMeta() without passing a context, including Helm's post-render workflow.
source_change.specific_change: Change `func (rn *RNode) GetMeta() (ResourceMeta, error)` to `func (rn *RNode) GetMeta(ctx context.Context) (ResourceMeta, error)`

expected_affected_files.reason: Helm calls manifest.GetMeta() at line 191 in splitAndDeannotate() to retrieve resource metadata annotations after post-rendering. The call passes no context and would fail to compile.

source_change.description: Change the return type of the ParseAll() function in sigs.k8s.io/kustomize/kyaml/kio from ([]*yaml.RNode, error) to (RNodeList, error) where RNodeList is a new named type with different iteration semantics. ParseAll is the primary entry point for parsing multi-document YAML strings into RNode slices. Also change StringAll() from accepting []*yaml.RNode to accepting RNodeList. These functions are used by Helm for post-render manifest merging and splitting workflows.
source_change.specific_change: Change `func ParseAll(inputs ...string) ([]*yaml.RNode, error)` to return `(RNodeList, error)` and change `func StringAll(resources []*yaml.RNode) (string, error)` to accept `(resources RNodeList)`

expected_affected_files.reason: Helm calls kio.ParseAll() at lines 162 and 184 to parse YAML documents into []*kyaml.RNode slices, and calls kio.StringAll() at lines 174 and 207 to convert RNode slices back to YAML strings. Both annotateAndMerge() and splitAndDeannotate() functions would break.

source_change.description: Change the List method on the dynamic.ResourceInterface in k8s.io/client-go/dynamic from returning (*unstructured.UnstructuredList, error) to returning a new paginated result type (PaginatedList, error). The dynamic client is used by tools that need to interact with arbitrary Kubernetes resource types without compile-time type information. Any code calling resClient.List() and expecting *unstructured.UnstructuredList will break.
source_change.specific_change: Change `List(ctx context.Context, opts metav1.ListOptions) (*unstructured.UnstructuredList, error)` to return a paginated result type `(PaginatedList, error)`

expected_affected_files.reason: Helm template engine uses dynamic client to look up arbitrary K8s resources during chart rendering
ArgoCD gitops-engine calls resClient.List() on dynamic.ResourceInterface for cache population, sync operations, and notification controller app listing

source_change.description: Change the Data field on corev1.Secret (k8s.io/api/core/v1) from map[string][]byte to a new named type SecretData with encryption-at-rest semantics and different accessor methods. Secret.Data is directly accessed by any controller or tool that reads/writes credentials, TLS certificates, tokens, or configuration stored in Kubernetes Secrets. Any code using secret.Data[key] map access syntax or assigning map[string][]byte literals will break.
source_change.specific_change: Change `Data map[string][]byte` to `Data SecretData` where SecretData is a new type with encryption-at-rest semantics and different accessor methods

expected_affected_files.reason: Helm stores release data in Secret.Data map, encoding release metadata as base64 byte values
ArgoCD stores cluster credentials, repository credentials, and settings in Secret.Data fields
Cert-manager reads and writes TLS certificates/keys to Secret.Data fields in issuing controller and reads secret.Data[cmmeta.TLSCAKey] for CA injection

source_change.description: Change the PipeE() method on RNode in sigs.k8s.io/kustomize/kyaml/yaml from accepting variadic Filter arguments to accepting a single Pipeline struct. PipeE is the primary method for chaining YAML transformation filters on an RNode. Changing PipeE(functions ...Filter) error to PipeE(pipeline Pipeline) error breaks all callers that pass individual Filter values like SetAnnotation() or ClearAnnotation() as variadic arguments.
source_change.specific_change: Change `func (rn *RNode) PipeE(functions ...Filter) error` to `func (rn *RNode) PipeE(pipeline Pipeline) error`

expected_affected_files.reason: Helm calls manifest.PipeE(kyaml.SetAnnotation(...)) at line 167 and manifest.PipeE(kyaml.ClearAnnotation(...)) at line 199, passing individual Filter values as variadic arguments that would no longer match the new Pipeline parameter type

source_change.description: Change the LoadChartfile() function in helm.sh/helm/v4/pkg/chart/v2/util from returning (*chart.Metadata, error) to returning (*chart.ChartFile, error) where ChartFile is a new wrapper type with different field access patterns. LoadChartfile is the primary function for reading Chart.yaml files programmatically. Also change SaveChartfile() to accept *chart.ChartFile instead of *chart.Metadata. These functions are used by ingress-nginx for CI/CD automation of chart version management.
source_change.specific_change: Change `func LoadChartfile(filename string) (*chart.Metadata, error)` to return `(*chart.ChartFile, error)` and change `func SaveChartfile(filename string, cf *chart.Metadata) error` to accept `*chart.ChartFile`

expected_affected_files.reason: Ingress-nginx calls chartutil.LoadChartfile() at lines 46, 54, and 107 and accesses chart.Version, chart.AppVersion, and chart.Annotations fields on the returned *chart.Metadata. Also calls chartutil.SaveChartfile() at lines 101 and 118. All usages in updateVersion() and updateChartReleaseNotes() would break.

source_change.description: Add a context parameter to the Filter interface in sigs.k8s.io/kustomize/kyaml/yaml. The Filter interface (with its single method Filter(object *RNode) (*RNode, error)) is the core abstraction for all YAML transformations in kustomize's kyaml library. Changing it to Filter(ctx context.Context, object *RNode) (*RNode, error) breaks all existing Filter implementations including SetAnnotation, ClearAnnotation, and any custom filters. Downstream consumers like Helm that pass Filter values to RNode.PipeE() would also be affected.
source_change.specific_change: Change `Filter(object *RNode) (*RNode, error)` to `Filter(ctx context.Context, object *RNode) (*RNode, error)` in the Filter interface

expected_affected_files.reason: Helm passes kyaml.SetAnnotation() and kyaml.ClearAnnotation() Filter implementations to manifest.PipeE() at lines 167 and 199. These Filter implementations (AnnotationSetter, AnnotationClearer) would need to satisfy the new interface signature, and PipeE which calls Filter() internally would propagate the breakage.

source_change.description: Rename the Annotations field in ObjectMeta (embedded in ResourceMeta) from Annotations to MetadataAnnotations in sigs.k8s.io/kustomize/kyaml/yaml. ResourceMeta is returned by RNode.GetMeta() and ObjectMeta.Annotations is accessed by downstream code for reading YAML resource annotations. Renaming this field breaks any code that accesses meta.Annotations via the embedded ObjectMeta.
source_change.specific_change: Rename `Annotations map[string]string` to `MetadataAnnotations map[string]string` in ObjectMeta within ResourceMeta

expected_affected_files.reason: Helm splitAndDeannotate() calls manifest.GetMeta() and accesses meta.Annotations directly for removing internal annotations from rendered manifests

source_change.description: Change the chart.Metadata struct in helm.sh/helm/v4/pkg/chart/v2 to rename the Version field to ChartVersion and the AppVersion field to ApplicationVersion. chart.Metadata is returned by chartutil.LoadChartfile() and is the primary type for Chart.yaml representation. Any code accessing chart.Version or chart.AppVersion will break.
source_change.specific_change: Rename `Version string` to `ChartVersion string` and `AppVersion string` to `ApplicationVersion string` in chart.Metadata

expected_affected_files.reason: Ingress-nginx accesses chart.Version and chart.AppVersion after calling chartutil.LoadChartfile() in updateVersion() and updateChartReleaseNotes() functions at lines 46-118

source_change.description: Add a DeepCopyContext method to the runtime.Object interface in k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/runtime. runtime.Object is the root interface for ALL Kubernetes API types. Every single type in k8s.io/api (Pod, Service, Deployment, etc.) implements this interface. Adding a new method breaks every API type and every downstream consumer that implements custom runtime.Object types.
source_change.specific_change: Add `DeepCopyContext(ctx context.Context) Object` method to the Object interface

expected_affected_files.reason: Helm kube client works with runtime.Object for resource creation and updates
ArgoCD gitops-engine manipulates runtime.Object for applying and syncing Kubernetes resources

source_change.description: Change the Deployment.Spec.Replicas field in k8s.io/api/apps/v1 from *int32 to *int64 to support larger replica counts. Deployment is one of the most commonly used Kubernetes workload types. Any code that dereferences or assigns spec.Replicas as *int32 will fail type checking.
source_change.specific_change: Change `Replicas *int32` to `Replicas *int64` in DeploymentSpec

expected_affected_files.reason: Helm checks Deployment readiness by accessing deployment.Spec.Replicas for comparing desired vs available replicas
ArgoCD health checker accesses deployment.Spec.Replicas to determine Deployment health status
VPA controller fetcher reads Deployment.Spec.Replicas for scaling target identification

source_change.description: Change the ObjectMeta.Labels field in k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1 from map[string]string to a new LabelMap type with validation semantics. ObjectMeta is embedded in EVERY Kubernetes API type. Any code that reads or writes .Labels as a plain map[string]string will break across the entire ecosystem.
source_change.specific_change: Change `Labels map[string]string` to `Labels LabelMap` where LabelMap has Get/Set methods instead of direct map access

expected_affected_files.reason: Helm accesses resource.Labels map directly for release filtering in list.go and for labeling storage Secrets in secrets.go
ArgoCD reads and writes ObjectMeta.Labels on Application CRDs and ConfigMaps for filtering and identification
External-DNS reads resource.Labels for annotation-based DNS endpoint configuration
Cert-manager sets Labels map on ACME challenge pods using direct map assignment

source_change.description: Add a WithContext method to the kubernetes.Interface in k8s.io/client-go/kubernetes. The kubernetes.Interface (commonly used as kubernetes.Clientset) is the typed client for all Kubernetes API groups. Adding WithContext(ctx context.Context) Interface forces all mock implementations and custom client wrappers to implement the new method.
source_change.specific_change: Add `WithContext(ctx context.Context) Interface` method to kubernetes.Interface

expected_affected_files.reason: Helm kube client wraps kubernetes.Interface for all Kubernetes API operations
Ingress-nginx store creates and uses kubernetes.Clientset for watching resources
Cert-manager issuing controller uses kubernetes.Interface for Secret CRUD operations

source_change.description: Change the ConfigMap.Data field in k8s.io/api/core/v1 from map[string]string to a new ConfigData type with typed accessors. ConfigMap is used for configuration storage across the entire CNCF ecosystem. Any code accessing configmap.Data[key] with direct map syntax will break.
source_change.specific_change: Change `Data map[string]string` to `Data ConfigData` where ConfigData has Get/Set methods

expected_affected_files.reason: ArgoCD reads argocd-cm ConfigMap.Data map extensively for application settings, OIDC config, and resource customizations
Ingress-nginx reads ConfigMap.Data for nginx configuration parameters

source_change.description: Change the Namespace.Name field path by modifying ObjectMeta.Name from string to a new ResourceName type in k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1. ObjectMeta.Name is accessed on EVERY Kubernetes resource. Any direct string comparison or assignment to .Name will break.
source_change.specific_change: Change `Name string` to `Name ResourceName` in ObjectMeta where ResourceName requires .String() for string conversion

expected_affected_files.reason: Helm accesses resource.Name as a string for Secret naming in storage driver and resource identification in readiness checks
ArgoCD accesses ObjectMeta.Name for Application and cluster Secret identification
External-DNS reads resource.Name for DNS endpoint source identification

source_change.description: Change the kubeconfig Config.Clusters field in k8s.io/client-go/tools/clientcmd/api from map[string]*Cluster to a new ClusterMap type with validation. The kubeconfig Config type is used by every tool that reads ~/.kube/config. Any code accessing config.Clusters[name] with direct map syntax will break.
source_change.specific_change: Change `Clusters map[string]*Cluster` to `Clusters ClusterMap` with Get/Set accessor methods

expected_affected_files.reason: ArgoCD reads and constructs kubeconfig Config.Clusters map for multi-cluster management, accessing clusters by name with direct map syntax

source_change.description: Change the Job.Spec.Template field in k8s.io/api/batch/v1 from PodTemplateSpec to *PodTemplateSpec (value to pointer). Job is used for batch workloads and is created by CronJobs. Any code that assigns job.Spec.Template as a value or accesses its fields without nil checking will break.
source_change.specific_change: Change `Template corev1.PodTemplateSpec` to `Template *corev1.PodTemplateSpec` in JobSpec

expected_affected_files.reason: Helm checks Job readiness by accessing job.Spec fields for completion status
ArgoCD health checker accesses Job spec for determining Job health status

source_change.description: Change the Node.Status.Conditions field in k8s.io/api/core/v1 from []NodeCondition to a new NodeConditionList type. Node conditions are read by autoscalers, monitoring systems, and node management tools. Any code ranging over node.Status.Conditions as a plain slice will break.
source_change.specific_change: Change `Conditions []NodeCondition` to `Conditions NodeConditionList` in NodeStatus

expected_affected_files.reason: Cluster autoscaler reads node.Status.Conditions for determining node readiness and scheduling decisions
Karpenter reads node conditions for node lifecycle management and drift detection

source_change.description: Add structured logging to the EventRecorder interface in k8s.io/client-go/tools/record. The EventRecorder is used by controllers to emit Kubernetes Events. Adding a new required method EventWithFields(object runtime.Object, fields map[string]string, eventtype, reason, message string) breaks all custom EventRecorder implementations.
source_change.specific_change: Add `EventWithFields(object runtime.Object, fields map[string]string, eventtype, reason, messageFmt string, args ...interface{})` to EventRecorder interface

expected_affected_files.reason: Cert-manager controllers use EventRecorder to emit certificate lifecycle events
Ingress-nginx uses EventRecorder for emitting configuration change events

source_change.description: Change the IngressBackend.Service field in k8s.io/api/networking/v1 from *IngressServiceBackend to IngressServiceBackend (pointer to value). IngressBackend defines how traffic is routed to services. Any code that nil-checks backend.Service before accessing it will have different semantics, and code assigning pointer values will fail.
source_change.specific_change: Change `Service *IngressServiceBackend` to `Service IngressServiceBackend` in IngressBackend

expected_affected_files.reason: Ingress-nginx accesses backend.Service with nil checks for routing configuration and endpoint resolution
External-DNS reads IngressBackend.Service for extracting service-based DNS endpoints from Ingress rules

source_change.description: Add a Cluster field to the types.NamespacedName struct in k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/types. NamespacedName is used everywhere for identifying Kubernetes resources by namespace/name pair. Adding a required Cluster string field breaks all struct literal initializations that use {Namespace: x, Name: y} syntax.
source_change.specific_change: Add `Cluster string` field to NamespacedName struct

expected_affected_files.reason: ArgoCD creates NamespacedName{Namespace, Name} literals for identifying Applications
Cert-manager uses NamespacedName for identifying Certificate resources in reconciliation
Crossplane uses NamespacedName for identifying composite resources in reconciliation

source_change.description: Change the rest.Request.Do() method in k8s.io/client-go/rest from returning Result to returning (*Result, error). The Do() method is called at the end of every REST request chain. Changing it from Do(ctx) Result to Do(ctx) (*Result, error) breaks all callers that chain .Do().Into() or access Result directly without error checking.
source_change.specific_change: Change `func (r *Request) Do(ctx context.Context) Result` to `func (r *Request) Do(ctx context.Context) (*Result, error)`

expected_affected_files.reason: Helm kube client chains .Do(ctx).Into() for Kubernetes API calls
ArgoCD gitops-engine uses rest.Request.Do() for applying and patching resources

source_change.specific_change: Change `Port int32` to `Port PortNumber` in ServicePort where PortNumber is a named type with range validation

expected_affected_files.reason: Ingress-nginx reads ServicePort.Port for backend endpoint resolution and nginx configuration
External-DNS reads ServicePort for constructing SRV DNS records from Kubernetes Services
